Hi @ncw,

thanks for all this great work. After trying lot's of tools, i'm considering to be a rclone fanboy already :)

I stumbled over a device specific problem. Uploading via `copy` and `sync` works fine, but `mount` will panic when i copy a file (just some kB in size) into the mount point, f.e.:

```
$ cp README.md /mnt/amazon/Dokumente
cp: cannot create regular file ‘/mnt/amazon/Dokumente/README.md’: Input/output error
```

This works fine on my amd64-debian8!

I'm happy to test and debug this further with some instructions how to that :)

- updated log output with `--debug-fuse` enabled
